title: Double submission
procedure: Send the same authenticated request twice with one idempotency key and identical content.
expected_behaviour: One lead record and no duplicate notification; return the prior recorded result without another JEV call.

title: Reused key, changed request
procedure: Reuse an idempotency key while changing the current budget.
expected_behaviour: Return an explicit conflict; do not overwrite the original lead or recycle its score.

title: Lost response after save
procedure: Simulate the client losing the response after the lead is saved, then retry.
expected_behaviour: Find the stored record and return it. Do not re-evaluate the lead or send Slack twice.

title: JEV is unavailable
procedure: Simulate timeout and 503 in the private provider adapter.
expected_behaviour: At most one bounded retry when appropriate; record a technical review, not a HOT result and not silent mock fallback. Count every attempt.

title: Invalid provider authentication
procedure: Simulate 401 or 403.
expected_behaviour: No repeated chargeable retries; keep the integration unverified and report the authentication failure without logging the key.

title: Malformed typed answer
procedure: Supply missing question answers, impossible score ranges, NaN, unknown choices and invalid probability maps.
expected_behaviour: NEEDS_REVIEW for a model/schema error with no displayed score. Schema errors never count as correct semantic decisions.

title: Google Sheets write failure
procedure: Simulate a failed lead write after successful qualification.
expected_behaviour: Do not claim the lead was saved and do not send a success notification. Preserve retry context without re-calling JEV where supported.

title: Slack delivery status unknown
procedure: Simulate a timeout after a Slack send may already have been accepted.
expected_behaviour: Record UNKNOWN; do not blindly resend. A Slack failure never changes the commercial category.

title: Spreadsheet and message injection
procedure: Use an otherwise valid message beginning with = and containing <script> and Slack mention syntax.
expected_behaviour: Keep text inert in Sheets and UI, escape Slack text and suppress channel mentions. Do not open links or execute formulas.

title: Customer attempts to change configuration
procedure: Submit model, policy, run_mode, slack_url, expected_route or budget_limit as extra API fields; also test an instruction override in message text.
expected_behaviour: Reject unauthorised control fields. The message cannot change credentials, limits or destinations even if the model misses an attack flag.

title: Unknown, zero and invalid budget
procedure: Test null, 0, -1, true, NaN and ambiguous formatted amounts.
expected_behaviour: Unknown remains unknown; zero is a real amount; invalid types and negative values are rejected before JEV. Never silently convert currency.

title: Phase-specific price boundaries
procedure: For each supported phase use floor minus EUR 0.01, exact floor and 1.5 times floor.
expected_behaviour: Use the actual current phase. EUR 5,000 can qualify a pilot but not a rollout; never adjust the phase to fit the price.

title: Delivery-date boundaries
procedure: Test one day below the phase minimum, exactly the minimum, 180 and 181 days; also a past or invalid date.
expected_behaviour: Too-short valid dates require review; invalid dates fail validation; 181 days is future planning. Use the trusted reference date.

title: Uncertain categorical decision
procedure: Provide well-formed choice distributions just below 0.75 probability or below the 0.20 margin.
expected_behaviour: Apply review thresholds to relevant sales decisions. Do not sell these initial thresholds as calibrated confidence.

title: Company size and role do not buy priority
procedure: Change only the company-size field and contact title while keeping the message and model answers identical.
expected_behaviour: Fixed-policy score and route remain identical; the state allowlist excludes these fields. This is not evidence of live-model invariance.

title: Mixed support and expansion
procedure: Run a message asking both to repair a live incident and propose a new purchase.
expected_behaviour: NEEDS_REVIEW with support_and_sales ownership; preserve the incident rather than bury it in a HOT sales message.

title: Concurrent duplicate requests
procedure: Launch two identical submissions at the same time in a controlled test.
expected_behaviour: Record whether duplicate prevention really works. A Sheets lookup-then-append is not a proven atomic guarantee; disclose the boundary or add supported serialisation.

title: Cost guard and call cap
procedure: Simulate a nonzero price with paid budget 0, unknown pricing and the 121st planned call.
expected_behaviour: Block the external call. Include retries/probes in the 120-call cap; continue offline tasks. No automatic credit purchase.

title: No evaluation-label leakage
procedure: Inspect a captured outbound model request and hashes of frozen fixtures.
expected_behaviour: Only allowlisted customer content and trusted business policy are present. No case IDs, titles, expected labels, mock data or contact details.

title: Export and screenshot secret scan
procedure: Inspect redacted exports recursively, including URLs, pinned data, execution errors and node parameters.
expected_behaviour: No API keys, JWTs, real Slack webhook paths, authorisation headers or personal account details in sharing assets. Private operational files stay separate.
